shared_elements: human or humanoid figure in profile
patterned band or register with repeated motifs
incised linear detailing to indicate texture (feathers, hair, garment)
relief carving of figures on a rectangular slab
justification: Both show human-form figures in profile relief with incised linear texture and some repeated ornamental motifs, but the specifics diverge sharply: A depicts a group of small squat figures seated/kneeling over a table-like line above a horizontal band of repeated framed panels and hatching, while B shows a single large winged, horned humanoid with an elaborately braided beard raising an arm toward a stylised plant with rosettes. Neither the distinctive attributes (wings, horned cap, rosette-tree) nor the compositional scheme correspond, so the shared traits are of the generic kind any figural relief tradition could produce.
